name: swept_at
description: UTC timestamp when the collection sweep ran

name: duration_seconds
description: Span of time in which the sweep ran measured in seconds

name: routes_attempted
description: Number of routes scanned by the sweep

name: rows_inserted
description: Number of rows added to BigQuery during the sweep

name: fetch_errors
description: Number of times collection.py failed to fetch a route

name: parse_errors
description: Number of times collection.py failed to parse the details of a route

name: insert_errors
description: Number of times collection.py failed to write parsed route details to BigQuery
